subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers revive one of the existing conflicting fork PRs, or allow a new clean upstream fix for the Feishu underscore-URL rendering bug?
rationale: The bug is narrow and valid, but current labels and open conflicting fork candidates intentionally stop another automatic fix PR without maintainer direction.

options.title: Allow a clean upstream fix
options.body: Open or promote one focused upstream PR that fixes the Feishu post payload builder and covers send/edit regression tests.

options.title: Revive a fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to rebase, address prior blockers, and provide real Feishu proof before upstream review.

options.title: Leave manual-only
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker until a maintainer or Feishu owner has time to sponsor the repair.

recommendation.title: Allow a clean upstream fix
recommendation.body: Open or promote one focused upstream PR that fixes the Feishu post payload builder and covers send/edit regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is within the Feishu plugin boundary, which the package metadata identifies as community maintained by @m1heng.
